outcomes: Two native WKWebViews: UI onboarding, invitation, MLS contact, message, reply and signed delivery receipts with automatic updates
Closing/reopening the UI preserves the same keychain-backed identity and complete history; independent daemon receives while UI is closed
Native permissions UI creates a scoped runtime; displayed config launches the bundled MCP, exchanges real peer messages, polls/acks durable inbox, and UI revoke denies the same live client

Native network settings configure an independent packaged relay/AutoNAT provider; real MLS and receipts flow through its circuit; daemon restart restores preferences, listener ports, identity and the original queued message

Native trust UI selects explicit trust, accepts a signed test checkpoint, automatically fetches it in a second packaged desktop through an entered peer, and restores identical trust/head/lease after source loss and UI/daemon restart; no live finality or spend balance claimed
